subject: general
question: Where was the BrahMos Aerospace Integration and Testing Facility inaugurated on 11 May 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **BrahMos Aerospace Integration and Testing Facility** was inaugurated in **Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh** on 11 May 2025.
 
• This facility is aimed at the **integration and testing of BrahMos missiles**, which are considered one of the fastest and most precise cruise missiles in the world.
 
• Lucknow was chosen strategically as part of the **UP Defense Corridor**, an initiative of the Government of Uttar Pradesh aimed at promoting defense manufacturing and boosting the local economy.
 
• The BrahMos missile is a joint venture between **India’s DRDO (Defense Research and Development Organisation)** and **Russia’s NPO Mashinostroyeniya**.
 
• The facility will play a crucial role in strengthening **India's defense capabilities** and fostering self-reliance in defense production.
 
• This step aligns with India’s **‘Make in India’ initiative**, promoting indigenous manufacturing and technological advancements.
 
• The BrahMos missile is capable of being launched from **land, air, sea, and submarine platforms**, making it versatile and pivotal for modern warfare.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Hyderabad, Telangana**__

 __
 
• **Hyderabad** is a major hub for aerospace and defense manufacturing in India.
 
• It is home to many facilities of **DRDO**, including the **Advanced Systems Laboratory (ASL)**, which works on missile technologies.
 
• Despite being an important location for defense projects, the BrahMos facility was not inaugurated here.
 
 
 
• **Bengaluru, Karnataka**__
 __
 
• **Bengaluru** is referred to as the **Silicon Valley of India** and is also a significant hub for aerospace and defense industries.
 
• It houses facilities like **Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL)** and **ISRO**, which contribute to the country's defense and space advancements.
 
• The BrahMos facility, however, was not inaugurated in Bengaluru.
 
 
 
• **Pune, Maharashtra**__
 
 
• **Pune** is known for its industrial base and defense training institutions like the **National Defence Academy (NDA)**.
 
• It also houses the **DRDO's Armament Research and Development Establishment (ARDE)**, which focuses on armament systems.
 
• The BrahMos facility was not established here despite its significance in defense manufacturing.
